evidence: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026 accepts Acalypha persimilis Müll.Arg. and treats A. ostryifolia Riddell ex J.M.Coult. as a heterotypic synonym.
A 2025 TAXON proposal seeks conservation of Acalypha ostryifolia against A. persimilis; nomenclatural outcome could change the preferred name.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: A Texas A&M floristic record from Uvalde County is filed under Acalypha ostryaefolia/ostryifolia, which current Kew places under A. persimilis. Texas nativity is secure at state level, but three exact target-zone native counties were not independently locked in this pass.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not infer county nativity from statewide or ecoregion occurrence.
